batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2013-2014-set2.pdf (4 pp.). ⚠ LISTING-VS-PRINTED SET-CODE DISCREPANCY (prominent): the Drive listing calls this file 'Set-2', but the printed header box on p.1 reads 'Set CODE: 3' — the printed code governs, so the paper id is ju-d-2013-2014-set3. Printed header: D-ইউনিট জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, বিষয়ঃ উদ্ভিদবিজ্ঞান (D1), সময়ঃ ৪৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমান- ৬০. The compilation prints each question with a ব্যাখ্যা and a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key (Bangla letters ক-ঘ, mapped positionally to a-d). Subjects assigned per question by content (Botany Q1-20, 28-43, 52-60; English Q21-27; Bangla Q44-51); Botany questions carry subject 'Biology' with topic 'Botany' under the project JU D convention. 60 questions, all 60 keyed, 0 dual, 0 dispositions. Several printed option-label errors (Q33, Q41, Q44, Q46, Q58) and one duplicate-option question (Q49) are documented per question. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

Aggregator footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com' and diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper. Two-column layout. Downstream cross-check partner (not used here): Satt Academy's JU D 2013-14 Set-3 bank (subcat 7118, stated 60) — identity to be settled at question level, since the D2 Zoology paper from file set3.pdf also prints Set CODE: 3.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪; D-ইউনিট জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; বিষয়ঃ উদ্ভিদবিজ্ঞান (D1); boxed set label 'Set CODE: 3'; সময়ঃ ৪৫ মিনিট; পূর্ণমান- ৬০.
